claim: Ibn al-Rumi's political patron was the last major Tahirid to hold high office. It was during the Tahirid dynasty.
evidencia:
Page: Ubaydallah ibn Abdallah ibn Tahir. Sentence: He was the last major Tahirid to hold high office, having served as the governor of Baghdad at various points between 867 and 891.
Page: Tahirid dynasty. Sentence: The Tahirid dynasty (Persian: طاهریان‎ ‎ , "Tâhereyân") was a dynasty, of Persian dihqan origin, that governed the Abbasid province of Khorasan from 821 to 873 and the city of Baghdad from 820 until 891.
Page: Ibn al-Rumi. Sentence: His many political patrons included the Tahirid ruler Ubaydallah ibn Abdallah ibn Tahir, Abbasid Caliph Al-Mu'tamid's minister the Persian Isma'il ibn Bulbul, and the politically influential Nestorian family Banu Wahb.
